steps.n1: تخلط الخضروات المسلوقة ثم تتبل بنصف مقدار صلصة المايونيز.

en.title: Russian Salad

steps.n1: Mix the boiled vegetables together, then season with half of the mayonnaise sauce.
steps.n2: Pour into a serving dish, cover the surface with the remaining sauce, and garnish with cucumber.
